<div class="card-body">
'''Veers''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが3名以上いる場合、配置することができない。同じ位置にいるスノートルーパーは全員、没収値に＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Veers-SWCA-97591.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダーの命により、ホスの反乱軍を殲滅せんとするＡＴ－ＡＴ攻撃機甲師団の将軍。無慈悲で冷酷な男。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Veers.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. He may move anywhere afterward. He cannot be deployed if three or more enemy unique characters are in play. All Snowtroopers at the same location are forfeit +1.

'''Lore:'''
The general of the AT-AT armored assault division ordered by Darth Vader to destroy the Rebels on Hoth. A merciless and coldhearted man.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Veers]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
